verdict.rationale: Brave's own API page advertises a self-serve, credit-based model ('Up to $20 in free calls every month · Prepaid credits, no subscription'), and a community comment describes users switching plans themselves, so pricing does not appear to require talking to sales. However, the pack never states an actual per-request or per-1,000-request rate, so the 'clear per-request pricing' part is not shown. missing for 10: explicit per-request/per-credit price figures, documented plan tiers with rate limits, independent confirmation of pricing clarity

support.subject: As a developer, I can see clear per-request or per-credit pricing without talking to sales
